name: Easy Chicken & Veggie Skillet Bake with Biscuit Topping

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and seasoning salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 tsp minced garlic
½ tsp seasoning salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop potatoes.
When the onion is soft, add potatoes, chicken, soup, frozen veggies, and milk  to the skillet, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups cooked chicken (shredded)
2 (298 g) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (340 g) bag frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Open biscuit tube, separate biscuits, and arrange in an even layer over the skillet. Place skillet in the oven and bake until biscuits are golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide skillet bake between plates or bowls and enjoy!
